motion: The camera does not move. The old woman tugs her white suit up over her cardigan and zips it to her chin with a look of deep suspicion. Behind them the man hopping on one leg loses his balance and grabs a bench. The woman in cream turns her head to the old woman and speaks, dry and slow, each word separate. She says: Five years, one toilet. Now he's fussy. Then she closes her mouth and pushes her arm into her sleeve. The camera does not move.
